rationale: Wagga Wagga City Council Engineering Design Services role open at Cadet or Graduate level: assisting senior staff with road, stormwater and sewer designs for tender and construction.

Mandatory items are a tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering (Marc's BSCE), Class C licence or ability to obtain, and a White Card or willingness to obtain; all met. Registration applies to the Senior level only.
Marc's Advanced Diploma covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, both named in the advert.
caution: No sewer design (coursework covered road and stormwater only); no 12d Model. Regional NSW relocation to discuss. Pulse portal may ask selection criteria questions not visible on the listing.
gaps: Has not used 12d Model, SewerGEMS, GIS or DRAINS
Design experience is coursework, not commercial
apply_instructions: Apply on Council's Pulse portal (https://wagga.pulsesoftware.com/Pulse/jobs, card 'Senior Design Engineer Civil (all experience levels)', closes 1 Nov 2026 11:59pm). No application email published; Geordi Paxton is a phone enquiry contact only.
employer_line: Wagga Wagga City Council's Engineering Design Services team delivers road, stormwater and sewer designs for tender and construction and will appoint this role at Cadet, Graduate, Experienced or Senior level.
title: Senior Design Engineer Civil (all experience levels), Cadet or Graduate level
location: Civic Centre, 243 Baylis Street, Wagga Wagga NSW 2650
